release_notes: '-R1' is a refreshed revision of the Rex 3D 5MP (base model IPC-GS2DP-5K0W); the R1's own model code was not found and retailers conflate the two, so listed specs fall back to the base Rex 3D. Sensor conflicts across sources (1/2.8" vs 1/3"); the R1 refresh may add full-color night vision and a larger microSD — verify against the official datasheet. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: record carried base Rex 3D values; per the Rex 3D 5MP-R1 datasheet: type turret → ptz (Wi-Fi P&T camera, smart tracking), resolution 2688x1620 → 2880x1620, sensor 1/2.8" → 1/3", FOV 77/40/91 → 88/47/107, max fps 30 → 20, microSD 256 → 512 GB, power DC 5V/1.5A → 5V/1A, IR-only/16x zoom feature claims replaced by smart full-colour night vision / 8x zoom, added dual-band Wi-Fi 6.

frigate.notes: IMOU uses the Dahua protocol; the RTSP path follows the Dahua realmonitor convention. ONVIF/RTSP is documented for this plugged Wi-Fi line but not independently verified on this specific SKU.

home_assistant.notes: IMOU uses the Dahua protocol; the ONVIF integration works.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile — IMOU uses the Dahua protocol.
